question: Who among the following musicians was awarded Grammy in Music Album category for his collaborative album ‘Global Drum Project’ along with Mickey Hart, Sikiru Adepoju and Giovanni Hidalgo?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zakir Hussain.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Grammy Award in the Music Album **category for the collaborative album ‘**Global Drum Project’ was awarded to Zakir Hussain.**
 
• **Ustad Zakir Hussain** is an esteemed** Indian tabla player,** composer, percussionist, music producer, and film actor. 
 
• He is the **eldest son** of the legendary tabla player **Alla Rakha.**
 
• **Recipient **of multiple Indian honours:
 
 
• **Padma Shri (1988), Padma Bhushan (2002), and Padma Vibhushan (2023).**
